description: This PHP class, MBVardefs, manages variable definitions (vardefs) within the SuiteCRM Module Builder module. It provides methods to load, merge, update, add fields to, delete, save, and build vardefs, which are used to define fields and relationships in CRM modules.

classes.name: MBVardefs
classes.description: A class that encapsulates functionality for managing variable definitions (vardefs) in SuiteCRM Module Builder. It supports loading, merging, updating, adding, deleting, saving, and building vardefs, as well as handling template inclusion and external file dependencies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MBVardefs object with module name, path, and key name, then loads existing vardefs from the specified path.

methods.name: loadTemplate
methods.description: Loads a vardef template from a specified file, merging its fields and relationships into the object's vardefs structure based on the grouping flag.

methods.name: mergeVardefs
methods.description: Resets and merges multiple templates' vardefs into the main vardefs array, starting with a basic template and including custom templates and implied implementations.

methods.name: updateVardefs
methods.description: Updates the current vardefs by merging templates, effectively a wrapper around mergeVardefs.

methods.name: getVardefs
methods.description: Returns the current array of vardefs.

methods.name: getVardef
methods.description: Returns the current individual vardef array.

methods.name: addFieldVardef
methods.description: Adds a new field definition to the vardef fields array, removing empty default values.

methods.name: deleteField
methods.description: Removes a specified field from the vardef fields array.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current vardefs to the file system, prepending a header.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and writes the vardefs to a specified path, including a header in the generated file.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads vardefs from an existing file if it exists.
